h1: AI Product Videos for Electronics, From the Box to Daily Use
lead: Show the gadget in a hand. A product link or one clear photo can become an unboxing, a setup, or a desk scene, with a spoken voice and captions.
card: Unboxings, setups, and daily-use scenes from one gadget photo.

faq.q: Do I need a shoot before I can make an electronics clip?
faq.a: No. Upload one photo or paste a product link, name the action, and download the clip. A 6-second clip is 24 credits, 10 seconds is 40, 15 is 60, and 30 is 120. A failed job returns its credits.

faq.q: Do I need video editing experience?
faq.a: No. Voice and captions come with the clip, and you can fix them in the editor on the same page. Prices, specs, and music you add stay where you can check them.

faq.q: Can I make several versions of the same gadget?
faq.a: Yes. One photo can become an unboxing, a setup, and a travel scene. Check the shape and the ports on every version before you try them as ads.

faq.q: Which electronics can I show from one photo?
faq.a: Speakers, headphones, chargers, stands, phone cases, and other gadgets with a clear shape. Use that product's own photo, and name one action, such as a button press or an unboxing.

faq.q: Can I make an electronics clip without hiring a creator?
faq.a: Yes. Upload one product photo or paste a link, pick a made-up presenter, and pay the credits shown before the job. Post the clip as an ad, not as a customer's review.

faq.q: Will the clip state my battery life or wattage?
faq.a: Do not trust the picture for the numbers. Add battery life, watts, and which devices it fits in the listing or your editor, where you can check them.

faq.q: Can I run the clips as paid gadget ads?
faq.a: Yes. The download has no watermark, and you can use it in paid ads. Do not overstate how well the gadget works.

faq.q: What video shape should I pick?
faq.a: Video shapes are a tall phone video (9:16), a square (1:1), a wide video (16:9), 4:3, or 3:4. 4:3 is a bit wider than a square. 3:4 is a bit taller than a square. A tall 9:16 fits a phone feed. A wide 16:9 fits a product page.

faq.q: Can the gadget clip include a voice and captions?
faq.a: Yes. Pick a made-up presenter and the clip can include a spoken line and captions. The numbers still belong in your listing, where you can check them.
